text: dsh-prompt-sharpen 是面向 DSH 网页端的提示词体检与定向优化插件。它在输入框工具栏加入按钮，也提供 /sharpen 命令和 sharpen_prompt、checkup_prompt 工具。插件用本地规则检查草稿是否包含输出格式、约束边界、验收标准和上下文；体检不调用模型。点击优化后，它把缺失项交给所选模型，只补齐缺口，四项齐全时仅收紧措辞，并允许一键还原原文。使用优化功能需要可用的 DSH 模型路由；体检本身无需模型调用。

dsh-prompt-sharpen checks DSH drafts for format, constraints, acceptance criteria, and context without a model call. Its composer button, /sharpen command, and sharpen_prompt tool fill gaps through the selected model route; checkup_prompt only reports gaps. The button restores the original draft.
帮我检查这段提示词还缺哪些关键信息。
想把草稿里遗漏的格式和验收要求补完整。
Can I tighten a prompt while keeping its original goal and requirements?
dsh-prompt-sharpen 的功能「草稿体检与定向补全」：在输入框按钮或 /sharpen、sharpen_prompt 入口提交草稿；本地检查格式、约束、验收标准和上下文后，只将缺项交给模型补写，并可从按钮恢复原文。
dsh-prompt-sharpen 使用优化功能时，会把用户提交的草稿和体检缺项发送到当前选定的模型路由；本地体检不调用模型。（见 index.js:193-208）

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · dsh-prompt-sharpen：Pre-send checkup for prompts in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

Most "enhance prompt" buttons rewrite whatever you typed. This one reads it first: a **zero-token lint** in the composer tells you which of four things your draft is still missing, and one click fills **exactly those gaps** — no padding, no invented requirements. The original stays one click away.

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · What it checks：| Gap | Looking for |
| --- | --- |
| Output format | result shape: structure, fields, length, table / code block |
| Constraints | what must hold, what must not be done |
| Acceptance criteria | how you will know it is done or correct |
| Context | the background, inputs or materials that make it executable |

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · What it checks：The lint is local, rule-based and free: it never calls a model. A red dot on the button appears only when a gap is found, and the tooltip names the gaps (`缺：输出格式、验收标准`). A draft shorter than 12 characters is not checked — at that size everything is missing and the answer is noise.

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · Directed, not generic：When you press the button, the gaps are passed to the model as a `【体检结果】` block:

- Missing items → fill those, and do not restate what is already written.
- All four present → strip redundancy and tighten wording, and **add nothing**.

The rewrite replaces the draft in place. The button turns into a revert arrow; one click restores the exact original text. A request that fails (bad route, timeout, empty completion) never touches your draft — the button just shows the reason.

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · Three ways in：| Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Composer button (left of the model selector) | check the draft, then sharpen it in place |
| `/sharpen <draft>` | same pipeline from the command line |
| `sharpen_prompt` tool | lets the agent tighten a prompt the user is drafting |
| `checkup_prompt` tool | diagnose only — no model call, no tokens |

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · Three ways in：HTTP, for the UI half: `POST /api/prompt-sharpen/check` and `POST /api/prompt-sharpen/enhance`, both taking `{ "draft": "…" }` and restricted to loopback, same-origin requests.

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · Install：Desktop app: open **Plugins**, search `dsh-prompt-sharpen`, install, then restart — client bundles are composed at startup.

Command line, for a `web` profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-sharpen
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and ships `cordis.patch.yml`, so it loads as a bundle without hand-editing the profile.

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-sharpen
  name: dsh-prompt-sharpen
  config:
    provider: deepseek-account   # default: the calling agent's route,

dsh-prompt-sharpen README · Notes：- Zero runtime dependencies. Both halves are plain ESM/CJS and only touch `ctx` services, so `link:` installs work too.
- The button never sends your message. You always read the result before pressing Enter.
- Only the draft you press the button on is sent, to the model route you configured. No telemetry, no storage.
- Client bundle lives at `client.js`; host half at `index.js`; both are small enough to read in one sitting.
